caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on an off-white background and consists of technical line art. Three rooms are depicted, each bounded by straight and dashed lines, with wavy segments indicating structural walls or partitions. In the left room, there is a rectangular object with a narrower rectangular shape inside, shaded with dots and horizontal lines, and mounted on the wall. The central room contains a similar object, also shaded, situated against the back wall. To the right, a person is shown in profile, drawn with simple circular and straight lines, sitting, and extending an arm towards a slanted rectangular element attached to the wall; dashed lines indicate the possible range of motion of this object. The far-right room repeats the previous structure, showing the slanted object in a different position, with overlapping dashed lines to indicate movement paths. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a linear scale bar marked in inches for reference. The entire composition is monochromatic, using only black ink on a pale background, and consists solely of schematic objects and figures without decorative elements.
title: Pa. German Box
